title: ENDURANCE B · STEADY + MOBILE
emphasis: Baseline plan. Tell your coach what you actually completed.

deposits.title: STEADY ENDURANCE

exercises.name: Steady treadmill or outdoor walk
exercises.cue: Keep a pace that lets you speak complete sentences.
exercises.prescription: 35 min moderate continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.
exercises.home: 35 min moderate continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.

deposits.effort: 35 min at a conversational pace. Start with 20–25 min if this exceeds recent capacity.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: ACTIVE MOBILITY

exercises.name: Ankle rocks + calf mobility
exercises.cue: Move slowly in a comfortable range. No forcing or bouncing.
exercises.prescription: Alternate gentle knee-to-wall ankle rocks and a comfortable standing calf stretch. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; heel stays down.
exercises.home: Alternate gentle knee-to-wall ankle rocks and a comfortable standing calf stretch. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; heel stays down.
exercises.away: Use the same comfortable unloaded movements, with a wall or chair for support.

deposits.effort: Comfortable active range; stop anything painful. No forced stretching.
deposits.label: B

levels.bonus: Optional brisk walk; dummy lab separate

weekSummary: Mon strength A · Tue endurance · Wed strength B · Thu endurance · Fri strength C · Sat boxing · Sun recovery

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · SINGLE-LEG POSITION CHECK
martialSupplement.home: Study one familiar single-leg entry slowly. Pause at contact to check posture and connection; do not drive or finish forcefully into the dummy. Up to 3 slow reps/side. Focus: Where can posture or connection be kept more consistent?
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Weekly question: can I keep posture and connection consistent while changing position?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
